analytic_probe.summary: Actual installed Python layer-read/regular-attribute/unique-dot functions pass mocked RNA IDs through seams, duplicate triangles and separate materials;100000IDs exact in float32.

limits: Source/analytic evidence only, not native export or skin/action preservation proof.
export_attributes=True exports every admitted underscore attribute; reject unexpected ones.
Modifiers/shared-mesh ownership require explicit guards; IDs alone do not prove unchanged topology.

lineage.admission: primitive_extract.py173-227 admits underscore attrs and uppercases names; rejects name collisions by skipping later duplicate
lineage.conversion: conversion.py88-102,113-126,145-159 maps INT to FLOAT/SCALAR float32; IDs below100k stay exact
lineage.point_to_corner: primitive_extract.py1368-1389 uses dot.vertex_index to repeat the original POINT value on every corner
lineage.skinning: primitive_extract.py852-868/933-949 gets weights independently from vert_bones indexed by the same native vertex_index; ID does not disable pruning
lineage.splitting: primitive_extract.py316-344 includes native vertex_index and every attribute in the unique-dot tuple; shared823-850 / per-material900-916 preserve the ID

pruning.extension_api: gather_mesh_hook sees resulting primitives and original mesh after extraction; attribute-change hook also exists but no supported hook controls min_influence
pruning.hook_failure_policy: user_extensions.py13-17 logs and swallows hook exceptions; never use hook return as a fail-closed success gate

recommendation: Snapshot all selected source body+fringe mesh points/≤4positiveweights and bone names in applied identity rest frames.
Stamp one global POINT INT source ID per native vertex after final topology/weight authoring; reject preexisting collisions and all unexpected underscore attributes.
Export with custom attrs enabled, no topology-changing modifier application or compression. Treat source IDs as float32 exact integers, not a5125 accessor.
Restore all exported skin rows, including body, from IDs and per-owner bone mapping; cross-check rest positions and oriented source triangle coverage.
Duplicate target IDs caused by seams/material splits are expected; each ID must select exactly one immutable source row.
Strip only the staging ID binding after guarded restoration; retain original raw export and bytes, public validator and original tolerances.
A real native skinned UV-seam/material fixture remains necessary before relying on the full Blender path.
